answer: Locks are recorded in vertex, expire in sparrow, and quill lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An hostile operator running 130 aliases hence needs 79 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3012 identities would post 4053 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
